system.$description: The platform's system font, for body text and controls: SF Pro on Apple, Adwaita Sans on GNOME, Roboto on Android (decisions/0011).

heading.$description: westron's heading font, Onest (SIL OFL 1.1), which every platform ships with westron; the system font where it is missing (decisions/0011).

mono.$description: westron's monospaced font, Geist Mono (SIL OFL 1.1), for code, logs and identifiers; the system's monospaced font where it is missing (decisions/0011).
